messages.guide.title: How to use this desk
messages.guide.description: A practical guide to finding evidence, organizing your work, checking property records, and knowing when information leaves this machine.
messages.guide.purpose.title: Evidence-backed NYC housing research, in one private workspace.
messages.guide.purpose.body: Use this site to search official sources and your own files, inspect the passages behind a result, check bounded NYC HPD violation records, and save selected evidence in local matters. It is designed for research you can verify—not for replacing an attorney or treating a generated answer as legal authority.
messages.guide.workflow.title: From question to reusable research record
messages.guide.workflow.description: Each step keeps the evidence, provenance, and boundaries visible.
messages.guide.step.sources.title: Prepare the source library
messages.guide.step.sources.body: Install the core publications, add optional official source packs, or import PDF, DOCX, Markdown, and text files. Personal files are eligible for provider-backed features only when you allow it for that resource.
messages.guide.step.question.title: Ask one specific question
messages.guide.step.question.body: Use a citation, legal topic, or plain-language question. Choose official sources, your resources, or both; answer language and reading style change the presentation, not the cited evidence.
messages.guide.step.mode.title: Choose the right research mode
messages.guide.step.mode.body: Automatic and source search stay free; generated answers use your provider; property lookup contacts NYC Open Data. Urgent-housing questions can also surface official help resources without a model.
messages.guide.step.verify.title: Verify the evidence and identity
messages.guide.step.verify.body: Inspect cited excerpts, open the official publication, and check that the law is current. For property records, confirm the intended building before creating a dossier or export.
messages.guide.step.save.title: Save only what matters
messages.guide.step.save.body: A matter preserves an immutable copy of explicitly saved evidence while its title, tags, description, and notes remain editable. A property dossier is a local snapshot tied to a confirmed identity.
messages.guide.modes.title: Choose by task and boundary
messages.guide.mode.auto.title: Automatic
messages.guide.mode.auto.body: Classifies the request locally. It searches installed sources for free or sends a property request to the HPD panel; it never starts a paid answer.
messages.guide.mode.search.title: Search sources only
messages.guide.mode.search.body: Returns matching passages from the selected official or personal resources without sending your question to a model provider.
messages.guide.mode.answer.title: Answer with citations
messages.guide.mode.answer.body: Sends your question and eligible excerpts to the configured provider. Spanish and plain-language controls change the explanation while preserving its cited evidence.
messages.guide.mode.property.title: Property lookup
messages.guide.mode.property.body: Queries NYC Open Data for HPD violations by address or official identifier. Confirm the building before summarizing, creating a dossier, or exporting records.
messages.guide.reading.title: Three checks before you rely on anything
messages.guide.reading.citation.title: Citation
messages.guide.reading.citation.body: Does the section or property record actually match your question?
messages.guide.reading.context.title: Context
messages.guide.reading.context.body: Read the full excerpt and nearby provisions, not only the generated summary.
messages.guide.reading.currency.title: Currency
messages.guide.reading.currency.body: Open the official source and check its date or lookup time before relying on it.
messages.guide.boundary.title: Know the boundary
messages.guide.boundary.local.label: Local
messages.guide.boundary.local.body: Installed-source search, imported files, matters, notes, and dossiers stay on this machine. Results are saved only when you explicitly choose to save them.
messages.guide.boundary.network.label: Network
messages.guide.boundary.network.body: Source installation and updates, live property lookup, and opening an official help link contact external services.
messages.guide.boundary.paid.label: May charge
messages.guide.boundary.paid.body: Generated answers, property summaries, and semantic indexing can use your provider key. Personal-resource excerpts are eligible only when you allowed provider use for that resource.
messages.guide.boundary.offline.label: Offline
messages.guide.boundary.offline.body: Offline mode blocks new application-managed network requests. Installed sources and saved work remain available, but cached HPD pages are not a complete property snapshot.
messages.guide.boundary.settings: Review privacy, offline mode, and spending
messages.guide.questions.title: Be concrete
messages.guide.questions.example.heat: What heat must a landlord provide during winter?
messages.guide.questions.example.citation: Find the text of RPAPL section 711.
messages.guide.questions.example.property: Show open Class C violations at a specific address.
messages.guide.questions.example.help: I have no heat tonight. Where can I get official help?
messages.guide.caution.title: General legal information
messages.guide.caution.body: This site does not give legal advice. Deadlines, facts, and recent changes can alter the answer; verify the official record and consult qualified counsel when needed.
